Pairing sessions

Group A · 1 of 3 done

Three one-hour sessions with a TA, booked in the pairing app during your group's week. Each session covers the skills shown with it, and its problem comes in parts, each in two versions. Your results on a part's skills when the session starts decide which version you get, and so the most that part can earn: 100% if you meet or approach expectations on all of them, and 75% otherwise. So attempt a session's skills before it: full credit is only possible once you're at least approaching on all of them. An attempt counts once it's graded. If you sign up with a classmate, the lower of your two results counts, so you both need at least approaching on all of them for full credit.
